scripts.dev:web: corepack pnpm run build:packages && node scripts/environment/dev.mjs web
scripts.dev:worker: corepack pnpm run build:packages && node scripts/environment/dev.mjs worker
scripts.env:smoke: corepack pnpm run build:packages && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/environment/smoke.mjs
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm run build:packages && corepack pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.test: corepack pnpm run test:unit && corepack pnpm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: corepack pnpm run test:unit:ts && corepack pnpm run test:python
scripts.test:integration: corepack pnpm run build:packages && node --test tests/integration/worker.test.ts tests/integration/environment-policy.test.ts tests/integration/evidence-outcome-contracts.test.ts tests/integration/api-conventions.test.ts tests/integration/organization-user-membership-contracts.test.ts tests/integration/magic-link-contracts.test.ts tests/integration/magic-link-security.test.ts tests/integration/resource-authorization.test.ts tests/integration/audit-event-contracts.test.ts tests/integration/pii-safe-logging.test.ts tests/integration/cross-tenant-access.test.ts tests/integration/openai-adapter.test.ts tests/integration/evidence-extraction-schema.test.ts tests/integration/rubric-to-evidence-mapping.test.ts tests/integration/model-routing.test.ts tests/integration/citation-validator.test.ts tests/integration/route-for-review.test.ts
scripts.test:ts: corepack pnpm run test:architecture && corepack pnpm run test:integration
scripts.check:architecture: depcruise --config dependency-cruiser.config.cjs apps packages && node tests/architecture/check-workspace-boundaries.mjs && corepack pnpm run test:architecture
scripts.check: corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm check:architecture && corepack pnpm build
